verdict.rationale: The API and adjacent programmatic surfaces cover a large share of the core UI experience. The Agent API gives web-grounded answers with inline citations and multi-turn context, and there is a raw Search API, embeddings, a code sandbox and structured output. Computer is exposed via MCP with browser control, login-gated browsing and 400+ connectors, alongside an official CLI and OpenAPI spec. However, several consumer UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, so true parity is not shown. missing for 10: API access to Library/history, Discover, Labs, Voice, explicit Deep Research/Pro Search parity, page-summary/browser-context features, and any independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
